# VDISC Test Fixtures

Immutable binary fixtures used by integration tests.

Tests must never modify these files directly.

If a fixture needs to be modified during a test, copy it into a temporary test directory first.

## Audio Compatibility Fixtures

Located in `audio/`:

- `valid.wav` — PCM WAV
- `valid.flac` — FLAC
- `valid.mp3` — MP3
- `valid.opus` — Opus in an OGG container

All four contain approximately one second of synthetic 440 Hz audio.

They are generated by:

```bash
./scripts/generate_audio_fixtures.sh
